_doc: Outline paths extracted from GNU FreeSerif (GPL with font exception; credit it). Units: font units (1000/em), y axis UP. Use them inside an SVG <path> with transform translate(x, y) scale(k, -k). Staff space = 10px in the prototype. Placement used in the prototype (bottom staff line at y=B):

placement.trebleClef: translate(0, B+0.6) scale(0.0588,-0.0588) → G line (u=180) lands on the 2nd line, bottom line at u≈10
placement.flat: box 12x27, translate(0,24) scale(0.03,-0.03); bowl centre (u=200) at y=18 of the box → box top = noteY-18
placement.sharp: box 12x31, translate(0,21.7) scale(0.03,-0.03); centre (u=190) at y=16 → box top = noteY-16
placement.natural: box 12x30, translate(0,20.25) scale(0.03,-0.03); centre (u=175) at y=15 → box top = noteY-15
placement.rests: one transform for all rests: translate(0, (B-30)+26.7) scale(0.0467,-0.0467) → whole rest hangs from the 4th line, half rest sits on the middle line; quarter/eighth rests centre on the staff
